_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
E ta'alo Klondike Solitaire oe. O lou sini e si'itia pepa uma i le fa'avae.

Tulafono o le Ta'aloga:
- Fa'avae (F1-F4): Fa'atupu mai Ace i King i le ituaiga
- Fa'aputuga (T1-T7): Fa'atupu ifo i le lanu e si'itia (lanu mumu i luga o lanu uliuli, lanu uliuli i luga o lanu mumu)
- Stock: Si'i pepa i le waste
- Waste (W): O le pepa i luga e mafai ona si'itia

Komiti:
- 'draw' - Si'i pepa mai le stock i le waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Si'i pepa i le va o fa'aputuga
  Fa'ata'ita'iga: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count e mafai foi ona 'all', lea e taumafai e si'itia pepa uma e fa'aali i luga.
- 'forfeit' - Fa'ai'u le ta'aloga i le taimi nei ma fa'atumau lou 'ai
- Igoa o fa'aputuga: W (waste), F1-F4 (fa'avae), T1-T7 (fa'aputuga)

E mafai ona e fa'ata'ita'iga komiti e tele i le vaitaimi e tasi e ala i le fa'akomi i le komiti:
  Fa'ata'ita'iga: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Na'o Kings e mafai ona si'itia i luga o fa'aputuga tuufua.
Gaioiga e fa'ata'ita'iga i le anotusi - pe afai e le manuia se tasi, gaioiga e totoe e skip.
Fa'aaoga 'forfeit' pe afai e te manatu o le ta'aloga e le mafai ona manumalo.

format_error.no_brackets: Faʻamatalaga e le aoga. E tatau ona i totonu o puipui faapipii gaioiga.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Faʻataʻitaʻiga le saʻo o gaioiga. Leai se puipui faaiu ']'
format_error.move_needs_args: O le faatonuga o le siitia atu e manaomia ai se punavai ma se taunuuga. Faaaogaina: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Count e tatau ona posetive po'o 'all'
format_error.count_invalid: Count e le sa'o. Fa'aaoga se numera po'o 'all'
format_error.unknown_command: Fa'atonuga e le iloa '{cmd}'. Fa'aaoga 'draw', 'move <source> <destination> [count]', pe 'forfeit'

action_result.before_failure: Faatinoina {n} gaoioiga (s) i luma o le toilalo.

move_result.drew: Na ia tosoina le pepa mai i se fale teu oloa e fai ma otaota.
move_result.cannot_draw: E lē mafai ona toso mai, ua leai ni mea o iai ma e leʻi toe maua.
move_result.invalid_pile: Igoa o le faaputuga e lē sa'o. Faaaoga W, F1-F4, poʻo T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: E mafai ona na o le 1 pepa e siitia atu i faavae.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Faʻaliliuina o le kata mai otaota i faʻavae F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: E le mafai ona siitia pepa otaota i lena faaputuga faavae
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Ko si kāti kopi mai le tableau T{src} i le fa'avae F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: E le mafai ona siitia pepa laulau i lena faaputuga faavae
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: E le mafai ona siitia mai faavae i lea faʻavae.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: E mafai ona na o le 1 pepa e siitia mai i otaota i laulau.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Faʻaliliuina le kata mai otaota i le laulau T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: E le mafai ona tuu pepa otaota i luga o lena faaputuga tableau
move_result.no_face_up: E leai ni pepa e faasaga i luga e siitia ai.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Saili {count} kaati mai tableau T{src} i T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: E mafai ona saili {count} kaati mai T{src} i T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: E mafai ona na o le 1 pepa e siitia mai faavae i tableau
move_result.foundation_empty: Faʻavae F{src} e leai se mea.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Saili kaati mai foundation F{src} i tableau T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: E le mafai ona tuu pepa faavae i luga o laulau T{dst}
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: E lē mafai ona ave i otaota po o oloa e teu ai meafaitino.

outcome.forfeit: O le taʻaloga ua faʻamavae. Faaiuga mulimuli: {score} kata i faavae.
outcome.won: Faamalo, ua e manumalo i le taaloga o Klondike Solitaire!
outcome.turn_limit: Faʻaiʻu le taaloga! E te oʻo atu i le maualuga o {max_turns} turn. Skoa: {score} kaati i fonotaga.
